Players Committee card image of [[Lieutenant Dopheld Mitaka (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3), marked “E1”. Source: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/4ab16f9b9c15499d865b4a7165ea8ddb0f451253/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/lieutenantdopheldmitaka.gif lieutenantdopheldmitaka.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit 4ab16f9 "Fixing case and making gifs", 3 July 2022. The file holds PNG data under a .gif name on the PC site.

Edits: none (file bytes as in that commit).

This 62×87 image is a nearest-neighbour reduction of the 1 July 2022 image [[:File:V8-D-Lieutenant_Dopheld_Mitaka-2022-07-01-0ab9fb8.png]]: reduced that way, the 1 July image gives exactly these pixels (mean difference 0). So it prints the same text as the 1 July and 5 July 2022 images (checked 27 November 2026).
